info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Weather Alerts Regions-v1-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a comprehensive list of regions that are currently under weather alerts. By utilizing this endpoint, users can monitor specific geographical areas for safety warnings related to severe weather conditions. The primary consumers of this API typically include emergency services, weather monitoring agencies, and developers building applications that support public safety. It enables users to stay informed and make timely decisions based on the latest weather alert information.

get.summary: Retrieve alerts for a specific region.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch alerts associated with a specific geographical region, providing critical information related to incidents or changes in that area.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify criteria for retrieving alerts based on region. Ensure that the necessary parameters are provided in the JSON format to facilitate accurate responses.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of alerts for the specified region.
